name: Sausage, Broccoli & Cheddar Egg Casserole
why: Egg/cheese-bound crustless bake (12 eggs + cheddar + heavy cream set around sausage and broccoli) - dish identity is the bake, not the meat. Published nutrition 463 cal / 25.7g protein / 4.2g carbs lands mid-band and clears both the 400-650 cal and <=35g carb gates with wide margin. Every ingredient maps to the board (breakfast-sausage, broccoli, eggs, heavy-cream, shredded/cheddar cheese, garlic, olive-oil). Scales cleanly to 14 in a sheet-pan/baking-dish weigh-and-divide. No seafood. Distinct from the accepted crustless-bacon-gruyere-quiche (different protein, cheese, and structure).
